thread:
PagerDuty Bot: [PAGER] incident triggered: high p99 latency across /v1/generate in hosted-west-1 (alert: p99 > 1.2s) -- paging eng-oncall (sev: P2)
Maria Chen: I'm on it, marking as on-call. any initial impact notes?
Rahul Patel: Seeing error budgets spike on the dashboard, customers report slow completions. I can pull SLO metrics and queue depths.
Ops-Bot: Deployment window: no active deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler events: surge scaling suppressed 3m ago due to recent scale-down cooldown.
Lee Wong: Ouch. Could be HPA scale-down + sudden traffic increase. I'll check pod counts and GPU pool occupancy.
Sara Kim: Noted customer heartbeat for a batch job that hits hosted-west-1 every ~5s; could be a thundering source.
Alejandro Ruiz: Sharing some quick metrics: request rate increased x1.8 at 12:07:11 UTC, queue depth rose from 23->410 between 12:07-12:10.
Maria Chen: Copy. Rahul, can you share the raw queue depth log?
Rahul Patel: Pasting recent controller metrics (k8s hpa / autoscaler):
```
12:06:50 HPA: desiredReplicas=8 currentReplicas=4 cpuUtil=35% customMetric(req_per_replica)=120
12:07:05 HPA: desiredReplicas=16 currentReplicas=4 scalingDelay=paused(cooldown)
12:08:20 Autoscaler: GPU pool saturation=94% availableNodes=2 pendingPods=12
12:09:00 Warmup-controller: warmupJobsQueued=9 warmupActive=0
```
Lee Wong: GPU pool saturation at 94% explains inability to immediately create more nodes. Also warmupActive=0 -> warmup didn't fire or failed.
Alejandro Ruiz: Looking at warmup logs (hosted-warmup) -- shows repeated PullImage timeouts around 12:07:30.
```
12:07:28 warmup: starting prewarm for model-redwood-7b-v1
12:07:31 warmup: PullImage failed: context deadline exceeded
12:07:45 warmup: retrying (attempt 2)
12:08:12 warmup: PullImage failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = image not found
```
Sara Kim: Image not found? Registry had a short hiccup earlier; there was a 503 range at 12:06-12:08 in the registry region.
Maria Chen: So hypothesis A: traffic spike + HPA cooldown + GPU pool near capacity + warmup failures -> request queueing and p99 latency. Hypothesis B: routing flaps sent extra traffic to hosted-west-1 while other regions were healthy.
Rahul Patel: I'm collecting traces for a few impacted request IDs. Example trace: queued for 1.4s waiting for free exec slot, then container startup 2.3s, then model init slower due to cold cache (~0.9s).
Lee Wong: Can we confirm if fallback routing kicked in? Ops-Bot, any routing policy events?
Ops-Bot: Routing change: none. Fallbacks not triggered. All traffic remained in hosted-west-1.
Alejandro Ruiz: Dumping pod list and node allocation snapshot:
```
NODE gpu-12 usedGPUs=8/8 pods=7
NODE gpu-08 usedGPUs=8/8 pods=6
NODE gpu-03 usedGPUs=7/8 pods=5
Available GPU nodes: 2 (but one in provisioning state)
Pending pods: 12 (waiting for node + image pull)
```

Sara Kim: Customer impact: ~12% of requests saw p99 > 2s from 12:07:10-12:10:40; some chat sessions had partial responses and retried. We should notify CS briefly.
Maria Chen: Live mitigations: 1) Temporarily increase burst-capacity pool by allowing cross-region spillover to hosted-east-1; 2) Manually scale GPU pool (spin up emergency nodes) if provisioning healthy; 3) Bump warmup retry backoff / fallback to prebuilt snapshots. Who can coordinate the spike spillover?
Rahul Patel: I can flip the routing weight for hosted-east-1 to accept 25% of new sessions. Doing a gradual 5% step.
Lee Wong: I'll request infra to provision 3 emergency GPU nodes (g4-style) and watch image pull logs. If registry 503 persists, use cached image in warmup-archive.
Alejandro Ruiz: Initiating warmup fallback: deployable snapshots available for model-redwood-7b-v1/snapshot-2026-01-05. Triggering now.
PagerDuty Bot: Maria Chen acknowledged the incident (assigned to Maria). Estimated time to mitigation changes: routing ~1m, infra spin-up ~4-6m, warmup fallback ~30s to activate.
Maria Chen: Thanks. Keep all updates in-thread. Rahul, paste exact command you used for routing change.
Rahul Patel: command: `redwood routing update --region hosted-east-1 --weight 0.25 --grace 60s`
Maria Chen: Confirmed gradual traffic shift started at 12:11:05 UTC. Observing immediate p99 improvement in east region.
Lee Wong: Infra reported nodes provisioning started at 12:11:20 UTC; kube events show nodes Ready at 12:15:02 and 12:15:18 for two nodes; third node pending image pull.
Alejandro Ruiz: Warmup fallback snapshot applied at 12:11:40 UTC, snapshot load completed 12:12:06. Warmup active=3.
Rahul Patel: Queue depth trend after mitigations: 12:12 -> 86, 12:13 -> 24, 12:14 -> 12. p99 reduced to 0.95s at 12:13.
Sara Kim: I've notified CS/Support: short post to affected customers with note "transient latency spike in hosted-west-1; mitigation applied; investigating root cause".
Maria Chen: Good. Let's track RCA actions in-thread:
- Action A: Investigate why warmup image pulled failed (registry logs + retry/backoff policy). Owner: Lee Wong. Due 24h.
- Action B: Revisit HPA cooldown/config to avoid stalled desiredReplica when pool saturated. Owner: Rahul Patel. Due 48h.
- Action C: Improve prewarm snapshot coverage and fallback path for image pull failures. Owner: Alejandro Ruiz. Due 72h.
- Action D: Add routing guard to trigger cross-region spillover automatically when queue depth > 200 for >1m. Owner: Maria Chen. Due 7d.
Lee Wong: Quick note: preliminary registry root cause looks like a transient GC job on the registry cluster that reclaimed older layers and caused a small window of 503s for image pulls. Will attach logs in the RCA doc.
Rahul Patel: For timeline building I'll export the autoscaler controller logs + HPA events windows (12:05-12:20) and share via the incident Google Drive link.
Alejandro Ruiz: Adding hypothesis tracker:
- H1 (primary): Registry 503 -> warmup failed -> insufficient prewarmed capacity -> HPA paused by cooldown -> queue build -> p99 spike. (evidence: warmup PullImage errors + registry 503 window + HPA paused logs)
- H2: Sudden traffic shift from routed clients -> localized overload. (evidence: rate increase + no routing changes observed, lower weight to confirm later)
- H3: GPU pool fragmentation causing scheduling inefficiencies (evidence: some nodes full while others underutilized)

Maria Chen: We'll escalate H1 in the RCA. For now incident is mitigated, marking status: under observation. I'll start the post-incident notes and assign owners for the actions. If anything regresses ping me.
Rahul Patel: Uploading the exported logs: https://drive.redwood.internal/incident-1749125678/logs
Lee Wong: I'll attach registry GC timeline and kube events to the same folder.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident status changed to: mitigated -> under-observation.
Sara Kim: Leaving on-call at 12:32 UTC, handing over to Maria for follow-ups.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. I'll run the RCA doc and link back here when draft ready.
Alejandro Ruiz: One last note: recommend adding an integration test that exercises warmup fallback under registry failure emulation.
Maria Chen: Noted. Closing live coordination thread.
